name: bilingual_retrieval_smoke_v1
description: Synthetic smoke dataset for validating retrieval evaluation code.

sources.title: Synthetic Graph Research Document
sources.content:
A checkpointer persists graph state after each execution step.
Interrupts pause execution so a human can review and resume.
Thread identifiers group consecutive runs into a persistent conversation.
Streaming can expose intermediate updates to a client.

sources.title: Synthetic Agent Research Document
sources.content:
A tool registry stores callable tools and their input schemas.
The agent runtime places tool results into its message history.
A citation validator detects identifiers not present in the evidence store.
Evidence retrieval selects candidate passages from stored page content.
